english.title: Cause / permit a vehicle / aircraft servicing equipment / person to be in an unauthorised area of Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) other than in an emergency

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

(C)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(D)_[aircraft servicing equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EQUIPMENT..),]_
(E)_[a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),]_

to enter those parts of Southampton Airport licensed for the surface movement of aircraft which had not been specifically allocated by the Airport Company for use by

(F)_[vehicles]_
(G)_[airport servicing equipment]_
(H)_[persons]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(9) and 2(2) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
